mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID AS roleId,TENANT_ID AS tenantId,ORG_ID AS orgId,FISCAL AS fiscal,ROLE_CODE AS roleCode,ROLE_NAME AS roleName,ROLE_TYPE AS roleType,ROLE_SCOPE AS roleScope,ROLE_DESC AS roleDesc,SKIP_URL AS skipUrl FROM PEACH_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID=#{id} AND TENANT_ID=#{actor.tenantId} AND ORG_ID=#{actor.orgId} AND FISCAL=#{actor.fiscal} AND COALESCE(IS_DELETE,0)=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FUNC_CODE FROM PEACH_AUTH_FUNCTION WHERE AND AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode} AND PARTY_TYPE='ROLE' AND IS_DELETE=0 ORDER BY FUNC_CODE

SELECT FUNC_CODE AS funcCode,OP_TYPE AS opType,RESOURCE_CODE AS resourceCode,RESOURCE_NAME AS resourceName FROM PEACH_AUTH_RESOURCE WHERE AND AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode} AND IS_DELETE=0 ORDER BY FUNC_CODE,OP_TYPE,RESOURCE_CODE

SELECT m.MENU_ID AS menuId,m.MENU_NAME AS menuName,m.MENU_URL AS menuUrl,m.FUNC_CODE AS funcCode FROM PEACH_MENU m JOIN PEACH_ROUTER r ON r.TENANT_ID=m.TENANT_ID AND r.APP_ID=m.APP_ID AND r.ROUTER_URL=m.MENU_URL AND r.FUNC_CODE=m.FUNC_CODE WHERE m.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND m.APP_ID='f73b300578a5436d82ec7fca2c07c284' AND m.IS_LEAF=1 AND m.IS_DELETE=0 AND m.IS_DISABLE=0 AND m.IS_SHOW=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PEACH_AUTH_FUNCTION a WHERE a.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND a.ORG_ID=#{orgId} AND a.FISCAL=#{fiscal} AND a.PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode} AND a.PARTY_TYPE='ROLE' AND a.APP_ID=m.APP_ID AND a.FUNC_CODE=m.FUNC_CODE AND a.IS_DELETE=0) ORDER BY m.SORT_NO,m.MENU_SEQ,m.MENU_ID

SELECT DISTINCT u.USER_ID AS userId,u.USER_CODE AS userCode,u.USER_NAME AS userName FROM PEACH_USER u JOIN PEACH_USER_ORG o ON o.USER_ID=u.USER_ID WHERE o.TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND o.ORG_ID=#{orgId} AND COALESCE(o.IS_DELETE,0)=0 AND COALESCE(u.IS_DELETE,0)=0 ORDER BY u.USER_CODE,u.USER_ID
SELECT DISTINCT PARTY_CODE FROM PEACH_AUTH_PARTY WHERE AND ROLE_CODE=#{roleCode} AND PARTY_TYPE='USER' AND IS_DELETE=0 ORDER BY PARTY_CODE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PEACH_AUTH_FUNCTION WHERE AND AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode} AND PARTY_TYPE='ROLE'
DELETE FROM PEACH_AUTH_RESOURCE WHERE AND AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode}
DELETE FROM PEACH_AUTH_PARTY WHERE AND ROLE_CODE=#{roleCode} AND PARTY_TYPE='USER'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PEACH_AUTH_PARTY WHERE AND ROLE_CODE=#{roleCode}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PEACH_AUTH_FUNCTION WHERE AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PEACH_AUTH_RESOURCE WHERE AND PARTY_CODE=#{roleCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_ROLE SET SKIP_URL=#{url} WHERE ROLE_ID=#{role.roleId} AND TENANT_ID=#{role.tenantId} AND ORG_ID=#{role.orgId} AND FISCAL=#{role.fiscal}
